items.rationale: Baiersbronn's Protestant baptism and family registers are digitised on Archion, not FamilySearch; the family register names both parents.

quirks: The Protestant parish registers of Baiersbronn (baptisms, marriages, burials and the Familienregister) are digitised on Archion, a paid site, not on FamilySearch.
